mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fwd_user(user_id, user_name, password_hash, org_id, status_code, token_version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{passwordHash}, #{orgId}, #{statusCode}, #{tokenVersion})
mapper.select:

FROM fwd_user WHERE status_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY user_id DESC

SELECT
FROM fwd_user WHERE user_name = #{userName} AND status_code IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fwd_user WHERE status_code IS NOT NULL AND user_name = #{userName}
mapper.update: UPDATE fwd_user SET token_version = token_version + 1 WHERE user_role != 'ADMIN' AND status_code IS NOT NULL
UPDATE fwd_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, token_version = token_version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.password_hash, u.org_id, u.status_code, u.token_version, r.role_code FROM fwd_user u LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.org_id = #{orgId} AND u.status_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY u.user_id DESC, r.role_code ASC
